tools.name: create_inbox
tools.description: Create an email inbox for this tenant and return it (id, address, display_name, created_at). Uses the managed mail.sentfrom.ai domain unless domain_id names one of your verified custom domains. The address is live immediately. Errors: 400 invalid local_part, 402 plan inbox limit reached, 409 address already taken.

local_part.description: Part before the @, e.g. "support" or "agent-42". Only a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore and hyphen; normalised to lowercase. Must be unique on the domain.

display_name.description: Optional display name shown in the From header, e.g. "Acme Support".

domain_id.description: Optional id of a verified custom domain (from add_domain / get_domain). Omit to use mail.sentfrom.ai.

tools.name: list_inboxes
tools.description: List every inbox in this tenant (id, address, display_name, created_at). Call this before create_inbox to reuse an existing address.

tools.name: delete_inbox
tools.description: Permanently delete an inbox. Its address stops accepting mail immediately; messages already received stay searchable. Cannot be undone. Errors: 404 unknown inbox.

inbox_id.description: Id of the inbox to delete (from list_inboxes).

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a new email from one of your inboxes and return the created message (id, thread_id, delivery_status). Starts a new thread; to continue a conversation use reply_to_message so threading headers are set. Recipients matching a block rule are refused and addresses that previously bounced are suppressed. Pass client_id to make retries idempotent. Errors: 400 missing fields, 402 plan send limit reached, 413 message over 10 MB, 422 all recipients blocked or suppressed.

inbox_id.description: Id of the sending inbox (from list_inboxes).

to.description: Recipient email addresses; at least one.

bcc.description: Optional BCC addresses (not visible to other recipients).

text.description: Plain-text body. Provide text, html, or both.

html.description: Optional HTML body. text is used as the plain-text alternative.

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key you choose (e.g. a UUID). Resending with the same client_id returns the original message instead of sending again.

attachments.description: Optional file attachments. The whole message must stay under 10 MB once encoded.

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient, e.g. "report.pdf".

content_type.description: MIME type, e.g. "application/pdf". Inferred from filename when omitted.

tools.name: reply_to_message
tools.description: Reply inside an existing thread and return the created message. Sent from the inbox that received the original, to the original sender (or to everyone on the thread with reply_all), with the subject and In-Reply-To/References headers set so mail clients thread it correctly. Block rules and suppression apply. Errors: 404 unknown message, 402 plan send limit reached.

message_id.description: Id of the message to reply to (from search_messages, get_thread or a webhook event).

html.description: Optional HTML body of the reply.

reply_all.description: Reply to every original recipient (To and CC) instead of only the sender. Default false.

attachments.description: Optional file attachments, same shape as send_message.

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient.

content_type.description: MIME type; inferred from filename when omitted.

tools.name: forward_message
tools.description: Forward a message to new recipients as a fresh thread, quoting the original and re-attaching its files, and return the created message. Useful for handing a conversation to a human. Errors: 404 unknown message, 402 plan send limit reached.

message_id.description: Id of the message to forward.

to.description: Recipient email addresses; at least one.

text.description: Optional note placed above the quoted original.

from_inbox_id.description: Optional inbox to send from. Defaults to the inbox that received the original.

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key; a repeat with the same client_id does not forward twice.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Fetch one message by id: from/to/cc, subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, direction, delivery_status, thread_id, timestamps, and time-limited download URLs for attachments. Errors: 404 unknown message.

message_id.description: Id of the message (from search_messages, list_threads/get_thread or a webhook event).

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search this tenant's messages, or list the most recent ones when query is omitted (the way to check for new mail). Returns up to limit message summaries (id, thread_id, direction, from_addr, to_addrs, subject, sent_at/received_at), newest first; use get_message for bodies. mode keyword matches words in subject and body, semantic finds messages by meaning, hybrid combines both.

query.description: Search text. Omit to list the most recent messages.

inbox_id.description: Optional: restrict results to one inbox.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List conversation threads, most recently active first: id, subject, participants, message_count, last_message_at. Use get_thread to read the messages of one thread.

inbox_id.description: Optional: restrict to threads involving one inbox.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Fetch a thread with all of its messages in chronological order, bodies included. Errors: 404 unknown thread.

thread_id.description: Thread id (from list_threads or a message's thread_id).

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft without sending it and return it (id, status draft or scheduled). Set scheduled_at to have it sent automatically at that time, or send it later with send_draft. With reply_to_message_id the draft becomes a threaded reply: recipients and subject default to the original message. Errors: 404 unknown inbox or message.

inbox_id.description: Inbox the draft will be sent from.

to.description: Recipients. Optional for replies (defaults to the original sender).

subject.description: Subject. Optional for replies (defaults to "Re: <original subject>").

reply_to_message_id.description: Id of a message this draft replies to; sets threading headers when sent.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC, e.g. "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z". SentFromAI sends the draft automatically at this time.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send an existing draft now and return the resulting message. Works for drafts in status draft or scheduled; a draft that was already sent cannot be sent again. Errors: 404 unknown draft, 409 already sent.

draft_id.description: Id of the draft (from create_draft or list_drafts).

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: List this tenant's drafts: id, inbox_id, to, subject, status (draft, scheduled, sent) and scheduled_at.

tools.name: add_domain
tools.description: Register a custom domain for sending and receiving and return it (id, status pending) together with the DNS records to add: DKIM CNAMEs, MX and SPF for the mail-from subdomain, and DMARC. SentFromAI re-checks DNS automatically and marks the domain verified once the records propagate; poll with get_domain. Errors: 400 invalid hostname, 409 already registered.

hostname.description: Domain or subdomain you control, e.g. "mail.example.com".

tools.name: get_domain
tools.description: Get a domain's verification status (pending, verified, failed), the DKIM, SPF and DMARC check results, and the exact DNS records still required. Errors: 404 unknown domain.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register an HTTPS endpoint that receives events as signed JSON POSTs and return it with its signing secret, which is shown only this once. Events: message.received (inbound mail, the default), message.delivered, message.bounced, message.complained, message.rejected. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff.

url.description: HTTPS URL that will receive the POSTed events.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. Default ["message.received"].

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List webhook endpoints: id, url, events, created_at. Signing secrets are never returned after creation.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint. Event deliveries to it stop immediately. Cannot be undone. Errors: 404 unknown endpoint.

webhook_id.description: Id of the endpoint (from create_webhook or list_webhooks).

tools.name: add_address_rule
tools.description: Add a rule for an email address or a whole domain and return it (id, kind, direction, pattern). Block rules are enforced server-side for every inbox in the tenant: matching senders are refused on receive and matching recipients are refused on send. Allow rules are recorded for reference and are not enforced as exceptions. Errors: 400 invalid kind or pattern.

kind.description: block to refuse mail matching the pattern; allow to record an allow-listed address.

pattern.description: Full email address ("someone@example.com") or bare domain ("example.com", which matches every address at that domain). Case-insensitive.

direction.description: Where the rule applies: inbound (receiving), outbound (sending) or both. Default both.

tools.name: list_address_rules
tools.description: List this tenant's allow/block rules: id, kind, direction, pattern, created_at.

tools.name: delete_address_rule
tools.description: Delete an allow/block rule by id. Takes effect immediately. Cannot be undone. Errors: 404 unknown rule.

rule_id.description: Id of the rule (from add_address_rule or list_address_rules).
